[[File:Marcello.png|thumb|220px|Marcello]] [[File:Young Marcello.png|thumb|left|220px|Marcello from 50 years ago]] '''Marcello''' (Japanese: '''マルチェロ''' ''Marcello'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP187|Moving Pictures]]''. He lives with his wife [[Sophia]] at the [[Sunflora Lodge]], which they operate together. Marcello and Sophia married 50 years ago and took a picture with hundreds of {{p|Sunflora}}. They continued this tradition for the next 49 wedding anniversaries. On their 50th anniversary, however, the weather was particularly cold and the Sunflora never appeared at the usual south slope location. {{Ash}} was able to use his [[Sun Stone]] that he won as a prize in the [[Bug-Catching Contest]] to evolve a recently rescued {{p|Sunkern}} into a Sunflora. This Sunflora went on to call the other Sunflora over, allowing Marcello and Sophia to maintain their anniversary tradition, and {{Todd}} took the commemorative snapshot. ==Pokémon== ===Befriended=== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Marcello |pkmn=Sunflora (multiple) |type1=Grass |img=Multiple Sunflora anime.png |epnum=EP187 |epname=Moving Pictures |vaen=Rachel Lillis |desc=Over the years, Marcello and his wife [[Sophia]] had befriended multiple {{p|Sunflora}} after taking a wedding picture with a field of Sunflora behind them. The flowery and bright backdrop led Marcello and Sophia to start a tradition of taking such photos during their wedding anniversary for the next 49 years. The couple's 50th anniversary was threatened because of the cold weather in the area. However, a Sunflora, which {{Ash}} just evolved, called hundreds of other Sunflora, allowing Marcello and Sophia to take the photo.
